name: Malawisaurus
sum: Malawisaurus is a titanosaurian sauropod from the Early Cretaceous Dinosaur Beds of northern Malawi, found at Mwakasyunguti.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: SAM 7405, a partial skeleton from Mwakasyunguti.
material: Newly collected material from the same locality was described in 1993.
